data.name: Varren's Expanse
data.detailed_description:
Build your force. Lose your mind. Come back stronger.

Explore and conquer the vast wilderness of the Expanse!  Guide an expedition from humble beginnings to becoming a vast empire.  Every round is in a new part of the Expanse, with new foes and discoveries.  Find treasures and glory, discover foes ancient and new, overcome challenges and escape traps.

Mice, Badgers, Rabbits, and Squirrels

Control a cast of heroic animals, carving their civilization out of the wilderness.  Send mouse and badger legionnaires, guided by rabbit scouts and squirrel skirmishers, to face down coyotes, moles, boars, and ancient, terrible foes.

Grow in Power, Round Over Round

Expand your forces, unlock new buildings and soldiers, and refine your tactics with every round in this roguelite strategy game.  Every round, win or lose, gives you progress towards improving your beasts' strength in battle and skill at building empires.
